Rossari Biotech Q2 sales up 19%, but profit rises just 5.4%

Net profit of ₹38.9 Cr trails sales of ₹698 Cr as finance costs and depreciation climbed, so growth is not yet reaching the bottom line.

▲ Positive · High ✓ Operating leverage · ✓ Sequential growth

ROSSARI · Exchange filing, read by AI · Sat 17 Oct, 7:26 PM Read ↗

Quarter ended Sep 2026 revenue Rs 697.6 crore vs Rs 586.1 crore a year earlier, about 19% growth.

Half-year revenue Rs 1,394.8 crore vs Rs 1,129.8 crore, up about 23%; half-year profit after tax Rs 74.0 crore vs Rs 70.5 crore.

Quarter profit after tax Rs 38.9 crore, up from Rs 36.9 crore; quarterly profit grew slower than sales as costs rose.

Finance costs and depreciation both rose sharply in the half year, and net debt-like borrowings were about Rs 149 crore (long term plus short term borrowings, less cash).
